}}'''Haesel''' is a servant in the [[Tarasin Palace]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Haesel}} She is slim and young with short black hair, a sweetly pretty face, silken olive skin and big black eyes
==Activities==
When [[Mat]] wants to see [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]], Haesel escorts him to [[Jen]].

She helps [[Olver]] move into his new rooms.
